div.div:
Hc: basal cell embeddings of line c
eg, pg: protein embedding and perturbation token of gene g
Xc, Ŷg,c: basal and predicted post-perturbation HVG expression
Δ, s: mean/variance shift and scalar response summaries
zc: mean- and variance-pooled Hc; qg,c: basal statistics of g in c
μtrain(g): gene mean over the 170 labeled training lines

text.tspan: Hc: basal cell embeddings of line c
eg, pg: protein embedding and perturbation token of
Xc, Ŷg,c: basal and predicted post-perturbation HVG
Δ, s: mean/variance shift and scalar response
zc: mean- and variance-pooled Hc; qg,c: basal
μtrain(g): gene mean over the 170 labeled training

div.style: display: flex; align-items: unsafe flex-start; justify-content: unsafe flex-start; width: 718px; height: 1px; padding-top: 507px; margin-left: 62px;
box-sizing: border-box; font-size: 0; text-align: left; color: #222222;
display: inline-block; font-size: 16px; font-family: Helvetica; color: #222222; line-height: 1.2; pointer-events: all; white-space: normal; word-wrap: normal;

div.div:
Every update (dependency batch, all 170 labeled training lines):
Ldep = Huberδ=1 ( δ̂(g, c) − [GeneEffect(g, c) − μtrain(g)] )
Every 4th update (+ balanced replay on four Perturb-seq anchor lines):
L = Ldep + λ [ MSE(mean shift) + energy distance(Ŷg,c, Yg,c) ], λ = 1
Trainable: STATE, adapter, head. Frozen: Tx1, ESM-2.
Head inputs use train-fitted standardization.
Dependency batch: 1024 (g, c) conditions per rank; replay batch: 64 conditions, 16 from each anchor (K562, Jurkat, HepG2, HCT116).
AdamW; learning rates 10−6 (STATE), 10−5 (adapter), 10−4 (head); checkpoint and early stopping on validation Huber loss.
